Class HumanTask

java.lang.Object
tech.kayys.wayang.hitl.domain.HumanTask
public class HumanTask extends Object
HumanTask - Aggregate root for human task management Manages the complete lifecycle of human tasks including: - Task assignment and delegation - Approval/rejection workflows - Escalation handling - Timeout management - Audit trail
